name: Abigail
source:
Mother to the twins [url=/c106072]Mia[/url] and [url=/c106071]Naomi[/url] and teacher at their school, Abigail must wrestle with conflicting desires and obligations at every step.

With her husband away, Abigail has to resort to other means to get satisfaction. Means that sometimes cross a line.

And then she has to try and control her troublesome daughters. She is under no illusion that they both revel in sexual cruelty, Abigail herself often fails to resist their evil charms.

As any good mother should, she will try to steer her daughters on the right path. But its going to be a bumpy road ahead...

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Abigail]DumbKoala[/url]]
